name: io.github.backenly/backenly
title: Backenly
description: Autonomous backend platform. Your coding agent builds Postgres tables, REST APIs, auth, storage, realtime, and functions over MCP, and every change is planned, verified, and reversible.

environmentVariables.name: BACKENLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scoped Backenly MCP key (mcp_live_...). Create one at backenly.com/app under your project, Connect, MCP. Read-only keys are supported.

environmentVariables.name: BACKENLY_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Optional project id. Used to detect a key/project mismatch.

environmentVariables.name: BACKENLY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional endpoint override for self-hosted Backenly instances. Defaults to https://backenly.com.
